points.interpretation: Registers callback C50E2F4 with filter 7 and user data 1.

points.name: home.add.item_name
points.interpretation: The card provider supplies the name for each candidate item.

points.name: home.add.item_icon
points.interpretation: The card provider supplies the image source for each candidate item.

points.name: home.add.item_register
points.interpretation: Registers callback C50D12C with filter 7 and a pointer to the card record.

points.name: home.add.event_code
points.interpretation: The add callback checks for event code 7 before adding a card.

evidence: The home registration routine copies eight descriptor pointers into a stack array and passes it to the app registration function. Creators and destroyers establish and clear separate main, edit, and add state slots. The main builder registers four scroll handlers; the edit builder registers add and confirm controls; the add builder creates candidate items and registers their add callback.
scope: Only listed creation and event call sites. Main scrolling uses a shared callback and pointer-valued user data; other widget editing and navigation paths are not intercepted.
limitations: Changing event data or skipping registrations can break navigation or card state; add-item event data is a live card-record pointer. Image sources and card records must remain valid. Page slots are not thread barriers. Device behavior and recovery are unverified.
